contract.purpleRock: DigOrCollectBlock permits purple rock directly; native dig handler does not deduct pickaxes for it; rejected TNT inventory produces not_enough_resource
contract.timedGems: Select with DigOrCollectBlock, wait dig_block_ret and the real current ore, use_tnt, wait use_tnt_ret, collect_mine x/y, wait collect_mine_ret
contract.path: Only native selectable timed ores with positive tnt_count and purple rock qualify; unknown or pickaxe-level-inaccessible tiles do not
contract.battle: dig_block_ret prepares monster; solve_adventure_event runs native battle; __mw_pending_monster clears in the native completion callback
contract.chest: Native dig_block_ret clears the chest tile
contract.camera: Native MoveTo derives viewport anchor from position.y-2; y-1 moves current digging location down on screen by one tile; coordinate label restored to actual position

verificationLimits: Public static client contract and simulated regressions; no live account, resource spending, battle timing or profits tested
